caption: Eating the Thanksgiving plate right now:
title: Eating the Thanksgiving plate right now 🦃

through_line.name: the stacked plate
through_line.prop_prompt: a white paper plate loaded far past its edges with a heaped mound of food, the plate bowing visibly in the middle, two dinner rolls balanced on top
progression: a huge flat shape blotting out the light above
the plate wedged sideways, refusing to fit
the whole plate lands intact and opens its eyes
the mound has spread edge to edge across the cavity
a second smaller plate descends behind the first
the plate lies picked clean and abandoned

blocks.through_line_state: a huge flat shape blotting out the light above
blocks.sfx: a distant clatter of cutlery, a deep groan, a slow swallow
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes looking up as the light above him goes out
CLOSE, low angle: Gut opening one eye, then both
MEDIUM, high angle: an enormous flat shadow filling the top of the tube
CLOSE on the eyes: Gut's brows climbing all the way up

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Gut. Brace yourself down there.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: It's Thursday. Why?

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: It's the fourth Thursday. The plate is coming.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: How high did she stack it?

blocks.through_line_state: the plate wedged sideways, refusing to fit
blocks.sfx: a grinding wedge, a paper crack, a strained wobble
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Gut listening hard, head tilted toward the tube
MEDIUM, eye level: the plate jammed crosswise, Pipes crushed to one side
MEDIUM, high angle: a second smaller shape queued up behind the first
CLOSE on Pipes' eyes, watering

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: There's a second plate. I can hear it.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: That's dessert. Completely separate trip.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Send both back. Right now.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Nobody sends anything back today.

blocks.through_line_state: the whole plate lands intact and opens its eyes
blocks.sfx: a heavy landing thud, a wet settle, a cheerful chime
shots: MEDIUM, high angle: the plate landing flat and level in the cavity
CLOSE, low angle: two warm eyes opening in the middle of the mound
MEDIUM, eye level: Gut pressed flat against the far wall
CLOSE on the eyes: the plate beaming, Gut blinking slowly

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: That is not a portion. That's a lawn.

turns.speaker: thanksgiving_plate
turns.line: Happy Thanksgiving! I brought everybody!

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Who is everybody?

turns.speaker: thanksgiving_plate
turns.line: Turkey, stuffing, mashed, green beans, and two rolls!

blocks.through_line_state: the mound has spread edge to edge across the cavity
blocks.sfx: a monitor blip, a chair scrape, a resigned sigh
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: HQ watching the hanging monitor, arms slack
CLOSE, low angle: on the pale screen, a hand reaching for a serving spoon
MEDIUM, high angle: HQ turning away from the screen too late
CLOSE on HQ's eyes going wide

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: HQ, we need to stop this.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: She's going back for seconds.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Seconds? There were no firsts. It never stopped.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: There's pie. I'm seeing pie.

blocks.through_line_state: a second smaller plate descends behind the first
blocks.sfx: a rummaging squelch, a delighted gasp, a soft thump
shots: MEDIUM, high angle: Loops surging into frame, coils everywhere
CLOSE, low angle: three pairs of Loops' eyes lighting up in sequence
MEDIUM, eye level: Gut sagging as Loops burrows past
CLOSE on the eyes: Loops delighted, Gut hollow

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Loops, take some of this. Please.

turns.speaker: loops
turns.line: Ooh, what's THIS one? Is that stuffing?

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Focus. I'm structurally compromised down here.

turns.speaker: loops
turns.line: I can work with this! Every bit!

blocks.through_line_state: the plate lies picked clean and abandoned
blocks.sfx: a distant couch creak, one long rumble, silence
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: the dark tunnel, amber light very low
CLOSE, low angle: Gut leaning in, exhausted, hoping
MEDIUM, high angle: Rusty's calm eyes opening in the deep shadow
CLOSE on the eyes: Rusty entirely unmoved

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: She's heading for the couch. It's over.

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: Let her go. She earned it.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: That's it? That's your whole plan?

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: Everybody sleeps. Nobody wins.
